notes: «أَبِی ره» is the first link, the compiler's father named only by relation (rule 7). The three co-transmitters of «حَدَّثَنَا» form one level. The Imam Abu Ja'far after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); «ع» and «ص» are blessings and are left out.
The chain flag «one position holds two names joined by و» is resolved as three co-transmitters at one level, not as an error.
